# E03 build plan

The design is greenlit by `docs/tdd/reviews/E03.astra-c1.md:1` with zero blockers. This plan does not reopen that review. Its six majors and one minor are assigned below. A design greenlight does not settle its explicitly pending contracts or establish implementation acceptance (`docs/tdd/E03.md:959`).

Repository inspection found no `hub/`, `ui/`, `packages/`, `eval/` or crew runtime configuration. `contracts/` and `config/` contain pharmacy assets only. All available other-epic task manifests were inspected, including E02/E05/E07/E08/E09/E10/E15/E21. None of their owned paths is assigned here. Recheck manifests at dispatch because supervisors are writing them concurrently. All task paths are exact leaves of E03 section 13 (`docs/tdd/E03.md:901`), checked against the other epic designs. No task owns an entire shared directory. The reference is `docs/product/design/interaction-prototype.html`, named by `docs/product/tdd/E03.md:9`.

## Build order and connection points

| Task | Concern and owned area | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | Daily-check record domain/application/repositories, configuration validation and component tests; `config/questionnaires.json`, `config/indicator-catalog.json` | E01 kernel, generated contracts, loader/storage/testing and agreed E03 record/core/pin/completion seams |
| T2 | Private journal application, sealed-store/reference adapters, private migration and journal tests | T1 marker migration/revision boundary; real E01 private coordinator and E02 vault |
| T3 | Crew project setup, `src/shell`, `src/design`, vendor renderer files, shell component tests and `config/ui-copy.json` | E01 generated TS workspace; coordinator-approved shell, E02 lifecycle and E20 bootstrap interfaces |
| T4 | Hub Today/HowYouAre projection application/API and component tests | T1 query declaration; agreed provider query DTOs |
| T5 | Today, daily check, How you are and profile feature screens; check/reaction component tests | T1, T2, T3, T4 frozen interfaces |
| T6 | Checks HTTP adapter, both module registrations, seam/fault tests, all E03 Playwright and eval acceptance | T1 through T5; actual scenario providers |

`tasks.json` is the exact ownership and command manifest. Start T1 and T3 independently when their prerequisites exist. Start T2 and T4 together once T1 freezes their shared declarations. Start T5 when its inputs are stable, then T6 integrates. T6 returns defects to their owning task; it does not rewrite their implementation. Freeze the T1 journal marker fields before T2 and the T3 shared client exports before E02 or feature consumers. No two agents edit one file.

The connection is generated HTTP client -> T6 checks routes -> T1 record use cases or T2 journal -> E01 UOW/private coordinator and E02 grants/vault. T4 reads provider ports, never their tables. T3 supplies privacy fencing, slots and design primitives; T5 mounts the provider features and displays API state. E22 owns rewards, E24 warnings, E25 routine, E26 help, E20 cache/queue and E14 comparisons. They are never copied into E03. E02's sessionLock integration consumes T3's published hooks; T3 must not wait for E02's later browser acceptance to publish them.

Component work can use only the published protocols and E01 `kernel.testing` fakes (SYSTEM 5 and 10). Those fakes do not exist yet. Their absence holds implementation; it does not authorize writing replacements. Component completion never satisfies T6's real-stack acceptance. Unaccepted reaction, profile, pin, core, repeated-question, freshness and cross-site features retain the design's unavailable interims and remain incomplete. No speculative reaction/profile tables, migrations or wire types are created before their contracts land.

Browser tests use Playwright against that hub and the actual crew app. No mocks, dependency overrides or replacement services inside the hub; external optional processes can be absent or use their documented adapter fakes. Load E21's demo fixture explicitly. Fault injection uses E01's documented test controls at actual storage/process boundaries. Missing prerequisite or absent test collection fails, never skip/xfail.

`test_fallbacks.py` owns the five E03 section-9 critical paths, each removing its primary: record entry/manual and printed backup; observed-time freshness/watchdog; help/cache/printed procedure; journal/shared vault/paired backup; warnings/routine independent loads. It also covers all ten AGENTS section-6 failure families. Shared mechanisms remain real. The unavailable state is checked separately from positive acceptance.

`test_performance.py` covers T-E03-100 through 108 against every E03 section-11 budget, including worst help latency under simultaneous model/camera/render/storage pressure. `test_workload.py` covers 111 with consented participants and interruption recovery. `test_pvt_timing.py` records actual device/browser/input/software/calibration evidence. Unavailable hardware and unsupported reaction cohorts remain unmeasured, never a passing claim. Use E20/E21 artifact paths after their manifests exist.

## Gates and hand-in

Exact executable commands are in each task's `gates`. Their source is `docs/tdd/E03.md:992`, `docs/tdd/E01.md:779` and SYSTEM 6. Python commands select owned tests/files under `uv run --project hub`; TypeScript-only T3/T5 use pnpm lint/strict typecheck/Vitest instead of inapplicable Python checks. Import-linter generates the entire installed architecture to include each new module. T6 also runs the full hub suite, all E03 browser files and eval paths. Gate configurations must reject zero collection and missing acceptance IDs. No filtering away failing tests.

The shared E01 `validate_hub.py safety` and `mutations` commands must explicitly include E03 before T6 can pass them. For `checks.domain`, `checks.application` and `views.application`, require covered branches / total branches >=0.95 separately for each module, using branch counts rather than combined statement/branch percentage. Modules with no branches are recorded separately and cannot dilute another module. Safety decisions in `checks.domain.answers`, `checks.domain.daily_check`, `checks.domain.reaction` and `checks.application.journal` require independently evidenced true/false outcomes of every condition and cyclomatic complexity <=15 per function. Mutation configuration must name those exact files, select `hub/tests/checks` plus the relevant `eval/scenarios/e03` tests, reject missing/zero selection and fail on every non-equivalent surviving mutant. Independently reviewed equivalence is evidence, never an ignore list. The E01-owned `hub/pyproject.toml` is the requested runner configuration path; E03 owns no phantom test manifest. T6's combined `--cov-fail-under=95` command is supplementary, not the branch-only gate.

An independent read-only review of these six task briefs found zero blockers, majors or minors. The final source refresh incorporates the newly available E05/E15/E21 consumer plans without expanding E03 ownership. Dispatch requires rechecking canonical provider files and settling the existing completion request; a proposal is never a contract.

All implementation gates are currently unrun because the toolchain/application prerequisites are absent. This planning assignment validates only JSON, ownership, dependency order, source paths, scenario coverage and writing rules. Before build hand-in, retain code/configuration/base/effective-contract/provider/lockfile hashes and exact command results; resolve independent review findings with evidence, maximum three build rounds; require CI and the coordinator's AI-use entries. No successful unavailable-interim test can close the full epic.
